extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from local XML/PDF figure captions and body text. Claims are bounded to observed membrane/phenotype/host-response assays; no receptor-level molecular target is inferred.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: HV2 and PG-1 increased E. coli ATCC 25922 outer membrane permeability in the NPN uptake assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: HV2 and PG-1; E. coli ATCC 25922
direct_assay_types: NPN uptake outer membrane permeabilization assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: Assay supports membrane permeabilization phenotype; it does not identify a single molecular receptor.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: HV2 and PG-1 increased inner membrane permeability of E. coli ATCC25922 as measured by ONPG hydrolysis.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: HV2 and PG-1; E. coli ATCC25922
direct_assay_types: ONPG beta-galactosidase release inner membrane permeability assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: The result is a permeability readout and should not be generalized to all bacterial membranes without further assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: E. coli ATCC25922 cytoplasmic membrane depolarization was measured after peptide treatment using diSC3-5.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: HV2 and PG-1 context in mechanism section
mechanism_claims.limitations: The local text/figure caption supports depolarization measurement; exact curve values were not tabulated in text.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM showed rough and wrinkled E. coli cell surfaces after 1x MIC HV2 or PG-1 treatment for 1 h.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: HV2 8 μM and PG-1 4 μM; E. coli ATCC25922
mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology supports membrane damage but is not a standalone quantitative killing assay.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: HV2 showed LPS-binding/neutralization context and reduced LPS-stimulated TNF-alpha production in RAW 264.7 cells.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Host-response assays are recorded separately from direct antibacterial killing mechanism.
